versions.content: Service Name Efx_Mod_<TypeMn> Syntax <Type> Efx_Mod_<TypeMn> ( <Type> x_value, <Type> y_value ) Service ID [hex] 0x122 to 0x123 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant x_value Numerator Parameters (in) y_value Denominator Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value <Type> Result of the interpolation Description This routine returns the remainder of the division x_value / y_value if y_value is not zero. Available via Efx.h
